fields.value: Evaluate players served by an inference server, and players with no checkpoint (LLM evals)

Follow-up to EXP-66, split out at Jack Heart's direction (2026-11-14): making LLM evaluation work is a follow-up Task for Etude and for Manabot, not part of EXP-66.

## What people said (Jack Heart, 2026-11-14)

* "I think the eval's that don't involve running any inference at all maybe a little more tricky but since you don't need to declare upfront how your system does eval, I feel like it should be doable"
* On the inference server (dictated; "a two" is Etude): Etude "does need to have the ability to spin up an \[inference\] server and then run \[eval\] jobs through that so I don't know what the API for expressing that looks like"
* Earlier, recorded in EXP-66 scratch/design.md: "there's got to be a separate process that sets up an inference server. Running an eval job involves enqueuing its work into the eval server but does not involve spinning up a new inference server"; "the eval job does run its own process but the process is the game engine. It relays the moves to the inference server rather than moving the entire simulation".

## Outcome

An experiment file can evaluate three kinds of seat with one `play(match)`: a checkpoint served by an inference server Etude starts, a served model with no checkpoint of ours (Qwen on vLLM), and a player with nothing to serve (Claude through an API, a heuristic). Manabot's two LLM experiment files (Claude, Qwen; MTG-329 checks them in not yet runnable) run under `etude eval` and `etude launch`.

## Proposal to start from (untested sketch, not accepted)

`Inference` gains a way to serve; Etude owns the server's identity (code, config, checkpoint), lifetime and placement, and hands `play` an endpoint:

```
@contextmanager
def serve_qwen(model: Served[QwenConfig]) -> Iterator[Endpoint]:
    with VLLMServer(model.config) as server:
        yield Endpoint(url=server.url)

policy = Inference(serve=serve_policy, config=Direct())            # seated with a checkpoint
qwen   = Inference(name="qwen", serve=serve_qwen, config=QwenConfig())
claude = Code(name="claude", source=[...], config=ClaudeConfig())  # API: nothing to serve

def play(match):
    seats = [connect(player) for player in match.players]  # endpoint filled in by Etude
    return play_game(seats, match.config)
```

Open: several servers on one machine or swapping; how a server's GPU need is declared when jobs carry no placement; whether local `etude eval` serves in-process; matches from several eval jobs sharing one server (controller placement).

## Also needed for API-only players

* A secret (API key) reaching the machine without being stored in the job.
* API dollar spend is not the rental's `max_usd`; Manabot's ledger can enforce it inside `play` if it survives an eval job's retry.
* Whether `Code` can carry a config (model id, prompt, reasoning settings) as the player's identity.

A list of gaps found while writing the Manabot files at Etude 9e8fec1 will be added as a comment. Seating checkpoints from other experiments and eval-only experiment files were sent to EXP-66 as a steer and are not repeated here.
